sources._comment: Primary source. One API call per location in preferences.json per sync. Free Developer plan = 50 calls/month, so sync deliberately, not on a tight cron. Get a key at rentcast.io/api. Key lives in env or ~/.config/apartmentfinder.env, never in this file.
sources.name: rentcast
sources._fixed_query_alternative: Or replace from_preferences with "query": {"zipCode": "62701", "state": "IL"} for one fixed search.

sources._comment: Optional Apartments.com source via RealtyAPI (realtyapi.io). One credit per location search; free tier 250 credits/month. Key in env/secrets file as REALTYAPI_API_KEY, or connect RealtyAPI in Muse and sync uses the vault credential automatically. Building-level results: rent is the low end of the building's range, beds/baths stay unknown. Skipped with a note when neither key route exists.
sources.name: realtyapi-apartments
sources._fixed_query_alternative: Or replace from_preferences with "query": {"location": "Springfield, IL"} (a ZIP also works) for one fixed search. Extra API filters pass through, e.g. "priceRange": "min:1000,max:2500", "bedRange": "min:2".

sources._comment: Optional second source: Realtor.com data via RapidAPI (apidojo Realty in US, ~500 free requests/month). Skipped when no RAPIDAPI_KEY is set.
sources.name: realty-us

sources._comment: Optional Zillow source via HasData (real Zillow for-rent search, no bot-wall fights). Free key at hasdata.com: 1,000 credits/month, no card; credits are charged per row returned. Key in env/secrets file as HASDATA_API_KEY, or connect HasData in Muse and sync uses the vault credential automatically. Skipped with a note when neither key route exists.
sources.name: hasdata-zillow

sources._comment: Direct listing URLs you paste in (Zillow, Apartments.com, Redfin, a landlord page). The importer retains only each URL. Portals often bot-wall automated fetches; a blocked page is recorded as unmeasurable, never as 'gone'.
sources.name: manual-urls

enrichment._comment: Providers run by `apartmentfinder.py enrich`. All optional: census-acs and fema-flood are keyless; walkscore (WALKSCORE_API_KEY), rentcast-avm (RENTCAST_API_KEY), hud-fmr (HUD_API_TOKEN) and airnow (AIRNOW_API_KEY) use free keys from ~/.config/apartmentfinder.env. Missing key or coordinates = skipped with a note.
